h1: Where to Buy Korean Skincare in Bali (and How to Avoid Fakes)
title_tag: Where to Buy Korean Skincare in Bali (Authentic K-Beauty)
meta: Where to buy authentic Korean skincare in Bali: COSRX, SKIN1004, Beauty of Joseon, Medicube & more. How to spot fakes and our K-beauty corner in Uluwatu.
intro: Forgot your serum at home? Ran out of your favourite sunscreen mid-trip? Korean skincare is easy to find in Bali, but not always easy to find *authentic*. Here is where to shop, which products work best in the tropical climate, and how to make sure what you buy is the real thing.
body_html:
Your options in Bali

  1. Specialist studios and boutiques — curated selection, advice from therapists, products you can test on your skin.
  2. Malls and beauty chains — a few big Korean brands, mostly in Kuta, Seminyak and Nusa Dua.
  3. Official brand stores on Indonesian marketplaces — good prices, but delivery takes days and you can't test first.
  4. Mini-markets and pharmacies — sheet masks and basics, rarely the cult products.

In the Bukit (Uluwatu, Bingin, Ungasan, Jimbaran), choice is more limited, which is why we opened a K-beauty corner in our studios.

The Point Face K-beauty corner in Uluwatu

Both our studios, in Ungasan and Bingin, stock the brands we use and trust:

  • COSRX — snail mucin essence, gentle cleansers, pimple patches
  • SKIN1004 — Madagascar Centella line, ideal for sun-stressed and sensitive skin
  • Beauty of Joseon — rice sunscreen and glow serums
  • Medicube — pore and firming care
  • Mediheal — sheet masks for after-flight or after-sun hydration
  • Biodance — overnight collagen masks
  • Utama Spice — natural Balinese skincare, made on the island

Every product is sourced from official distributors. Our therapists can recommend a routine after your facial, based on your skin analysis.

Best Korean products for Bali's climate

Need What to look for Why it works in Bali
Sun protection Light Korean sun serum, SPF 50 PA++++ Doesn't feel greasy in humidity
Dehydration Snail mucin or hyaluronic essence Hydrates without heavy cream
Redness after sun Centella (cica) ampoule Calms heat and irritation
Breakouts BHA toner, pimple patches Controls sweat-clogged pores
Glow Rice or niacinamide serum Evens tone, brightens

How to spot fake K-beauty

  • Price far below the official retail price
  • Blurry printing, spelling errors or missing Korean text
  • No BPOM registration number (Indonesia's product authority) on locally sold items
  • Unusual smell, texture or colour compared with what you know

When in doubt, buy from the official brand store or a studio that uses the product professionally.

faq: Can I buy COSRX in Bali?
Yes. We stock COSRX at Point Face Ungasan and Bingin.
Is Korean skincare cheaper in Bali than in Europe or Australia?
Often similar or slightly cheaper, but check that the product is authentic.
Which Korean sunscreen is best for Bali?
A lightweight SPF 50 PA++++ sun serum or rice sunscreen, re-applied every 2 hours.
Do I need a facial to shop at your corner?
No, walk in during opening hours. Our team can help you choose.
